options.title: 补拍使用过程
options.guidanceNL: Shoot a 4 second vertical hand-only clip opening the cap and taking one sip; keep the label readable and the background clean.
options.framing: vertical hand/neck-down shot, product and action visible

options.title: Usage placeholder card
options.editingGuidanceNL: Use asset_002 as the base layer, add a step 1/2/3 motion card emphasizing the open-cap action; keep the original product label visible and add no unverified claims.

options.prompt: Prompt brief only, not rendered output. Create a 9:16 ordinary smartphone-style usage shot: hand-only, opening cap and drinking, realistic and casual. Do not invent price, promotion, medical benefit, celebrity endorsement, or extra brands.
options.negativePrompt: no text overlays, no watermark, no celebrity, no other brands, no price promotion, no medical claims

options.title: CTA card
options.editingGuidanceNL: Build a CTA lock-up card using the product reference as the center layer with a clean hold and CTA reveal; keep the label visible and add no unverified claims.
